scope: Original Aguni and Okushiri airport OD applicability only. No code/input/generator changes, no contacts/bookings/forms.
primaryConclusion: Original TASK086 does not impose a numerical minimum reservation lead on every real service. Required broad reservation semantics and real directional service/endpoint/source proof remain. Unknown minimum lead must stay null/UNKNOWN, never zero or inherited30. A genuinely operator-confirmed exact reservation can satisfy a confirmation-dependent use predicate without reverse-engineering an unpublished deadline; a request/plan/user promise cannot. This review does not claim that any actual reservation has been obtained.

clauses.quote: Static topology and dynamic metrics are separate acceptance layers.
clauses.effect: Missing dynamic detail cannot erase otherwise proven topology; this is not permission to invent a usable departure.

clauses.quote: A directed topology segment supported by a real line / route / service pattern.
clauses.effect: Exact identities, direction, mode/service reference and provenance required; no mandatory numeric booking field.
Original schema explicitly permits unresolved reservation metadata. For these services reservation REQUIRED is known; only cutoff value is UNKNOWN.
Source-dependent broad conditions are static; original task does not demand one universal30-minute lead.

clauses.quote: If dynamic fields are unavailable, use explicit unresolved reasons. Topology can still PASS without them.
clauses.effect: Do not present time feasibility/live availability/dispatch as resolved.

clauses.quote: topology-confirmed edge provenance = 100%; both endpoints admitted = 100%; directed semantics = 100%
clauses.effect: Confirmation does not waive lawful sources, endpoint identity, service directions, required national path or boarding restrictions.

clauses.quote: airport-to-surface-network structural coverage PASS where service exists
clauses.effect: Gate is structural. A later numeric-lead profile cannot silently become a new universal original requirement.
Report unresolved booking detail independently with source/freshness/reason.

currentAdapterCorrection.minimum30: Lines144-147 belong to the original narrow PUBLIC_VISITOR PHONE profile (SouthDaito), not Noto.
currentAdapterCorrection.noto: Noto explicit separate contractKind NOTO_FLIGHT_ASSOCIATED_PUBLIC_OD_V1 uses previous-day15:00 and assigned-place/operator-confirmation conditions (lines39-64,652-681); it does not use30minutes.
currentAdapterCorrection.constraint: Neither source-specific contract may be silently generalized or weakened. New operator-specific unknown-cutoff semantics would be a separate reviewed profile, leaving both prior contracts/negatives unchanged.

semanticSeparation.staticService: Prove current shared/demand passenger service, public or exact qualification, actual airport and exact supported other endpoint/area, independent directions, lawful provenance and operating validity. No fixed calls from OD area membership.
semanticSeparation.deadline: minimumLeadMinutes:null, leadTimeKnowledge:UNKNOWN_NOT_PUBLISHED; known reception and operating windows separate. Never evaluate null as0.
semanticSeparation.request: REQUESTED / INTENDED / WILL_CONFIRM / user acceptance of uncertainty does not imply accepted booking; no confirmed-status witness from these states.
semanticSeparation.confirmedUse: A distinct operator-confirmed use context binds exact service/contract/source version, operator, two selected endpoint identities, direction, service date and accepted pickup arrangement. An inbound confirmation cannot automatically authorize return; both directions need separate confirmations if actual use is the witness.
semanticSeparation.confirmationEvidence: Do not accept an unbound operatorConfirmed:true boolean. Existing permitted confirmation information must identify provenance/trusted origin and exact booking scope; no real customer details need enter the public static dataset. No confirmation artifact was supplied in current caches, so this review supplies no actual-confirmed-use PASS.
semanticSeparation.structuralVsBooking: A structural conditional capability proposition is not a claim that somebody has booked. Original spec does not require procuring customer reservations to prove a service exists. If introducing a separate reviewed structural capability view, label that proposition explicitly and prove original structural obligations; never feed its assumed conditions into the ordinary actual-confirmed query as real confirmation. This is a separate design choice for root review, not implemented here.
semanticSeparation.expiry: Cancellation, denied/revoked/expired confirmation, changed endpoints/operator, wrong date, withdrawn source permission, changed source/native hashes or service outside published validity must deny/reopen; a confirmation does not authorize service beyond its source scope.
semanticSeparation.unknowns: Keep payment/precise route/dispatch/capacity UNKNOWN where unpublished; do not inherit Noto cash, SouthDaito cash/30min, or Yamato 24h actual ride service.

minimalNegativeTestsProposed: Unknown lead cannot be treated as0 or satisfied by any elapsed30-minute interval.
REQUESTED/INTENDED/FUTURE_CONFIRMATION and bare unbound operatorConfirmed flag reject.
Confirmed other service/operator/endpoint/date/direction rejects; one direction does not prove reverse.
Expired/cancelled/revoked or denied confirmation rejects; no seat/dispatch guarantee inferred.
Default ordinary query cannot use confirmation-required OD; PUBLIC eligibility alone is insufficient confirmation.
Changed native facility/source/rights/version or missing mandatory condition rejects/reopens.
Reception24h is not operation24h; pickup outside published service/validity rejects.
SouthDaito30 and Noto previous-day15 contracts/old outputs stay identical.
Aguni old fixed timetable cannot be admitted through UNKNOWN-lead branch, and historical30 cannot be relabeled current.
Okushiri fixed-bus terms cannot be substituted for island-wide ride-share terms.
No source assertion of precise service endpoint/area cannot be repaired by coordinate proximity or an invented confirmation.
nextConcreteAction: First choose explicit structural-capability versus actual-confirmed-use scope and make them visibly distinct. Then source-bound independent profile can reuse native OD admission and strict graph validation; no arbitrary numeric cutoff. Do not contact operator, submit forms or fabricate bookings. Existing factual service/source/endpoint review can proceed from current caches while actual-use confirmation remains absent.
